Here is how our refills work, and what happens to the pouch. Journal refills studio When we started Kinfolk, every product came in glass. Glass is beautiful, it keeps formulas stable and it lasts for years. But shipping a brand new bottle every time someone ran out of cleanser made very little sense, so after our first year we started working on refills. How it works Keep your first bottle. Every Kinfolk bottle is made to be used for years, with a pump you can take apart and rinse. Order the refill when it runs low. The refill cleansing gel , refill balancing tonic and refill hand wash hold two fills each. Pour it in. Rinse the bottle with warm water, let it dry, and pour the refill in through the wide neck.
